strongest_fit: Structured course dashboards and team task databases
source_model: Database relations/rollups; pages and shared views
extraction: Authorized Markdown/HTML + CSV/attachments or approved structured retrieval
graph_mapping: Map stable page/database IDs; relation URLs become candidate typed edges; preserve source snapshot
migration_risks: Relations exported as text URLs; CSV cannot restore original relational semantics automatically; formulas/rollups need definitions or explicit snapshot labels
activation_gate: Import rehearsal, human-reviewed relation recovery and no permission expansion
selector_recommendation: Use for structured collaborative authoring; connect first, migrate selected private work

strongest_fit: Private linked academic notes and portable personal knowledge
source_model: Local Markdown vault, internal links and note graph
extraction: Student-selected vault copy excluding secrets/config/plugin code by default
graph_mapping: Preserve paths, stable IDs, frontmatter, aliases, attachments, headings and link targets; links initially related_to not prerequisites
migration_risks: Ambiguous filenames, broken links, embeds and plugin-dependent semantics; backlinks do not prove academic requirement authority
activation_gate: Resolve link manifest; preserve Markdown portability; private by default; review each unknown typed mapping
selector_recommendation: Use when local files, offline notes and portability dominate; optional Semester private graph import

strongest_fit: Collaborative documents and institution-managed shared files
extraction: Scoped link-first; selected permitted exports/copies where owner permits
graph_mapping: Store source file ID, version, rights, source scope and course/objective/resource links
migration_risks: Native collaboration/history, Sheets formulas, conversions, parent permissions and institutional ownership do not automatically migrate
activation_gate: Validate file bytes/conversion, source access and grants; institution authorizes official/shared-drive changes
selector_recommendation: Retain for collaborative authoring; Semester can unify context and resources without recreating editors first
